summary: The customer called in an angry state demanding the immediate cancellation of his internet and landline subscription due to persistent slow speeds and unaddressed technical support tickets. The agent apologized, validated his frustration, successfully de-escalated the situation by offering a 50% discount and a free speed upgrade with no cancellation penalty if performance does not improve, and ultimately convinced the customer to give the company a second chance. The call ended cordially with the customer satisfied.

evidence.text: وإذا وافقت، أنا راح أتابع موضوعك مع فريق الصيانة بنفسي اليوم قبل نهاية الدوام لضمان تحسين البود والخط عندك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: The agent promised to personally follow up with the maintenance team by the end of the day to ensure line improvement.

evidence.text: وراح أبعث لك رسالة نصية برقم مرئي خاص بمتابعتي المباشرة عشان تتواصل معي شخصياً لو احتجت أي شي.
evidence.speaker: Agent
